findings.title: lane-scheduler-spec.md and quota-pacing-design.md use stale claude-opus-4-7 model ID (current is claude-opus-4-8)
findings.detail: Three occurrences in lane-scheduler-spec.md (JSON examples and schema rules note) and one in the quota-pacing-design.md weight table reference claude-opus-4-7. The current Opus model is claude-opus-4-8. The implementation note already recommends prefix matching which handles version drift, but keeping example values current prevents confusion for developers reading the spec. Previously flagged as AUDIT-audit-elevation-a5d1b8c4 (2026-05-22); the prior fix added the prefix-match note but did not update the example model IDs themselves.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace all claude-opus-4-7 occurrences with claude-opus-4-8 in both files.
